headline: Sensex and Nifty End Marginally Lower in Tepid Muhurat Trading Session, Snapping Seven-Day Winning Streak

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Sensex and Nifty edged marginally lower during the Muhurat trading session, pausing after a seven-day rally.
Indian stocks ended in the red on Diwali for the first time in eight years.
Samvat 2083 got off to a tepid start as headline indices slipped slightly while smaller companies saw gains.
The minor dip comes right after Indian equities posted their best weekly performance in six years.
whatHappening: BSE and NSE conducted the special annual Muhurat trading session on Diwali Laxmi Pujan.
Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty saw a tiny drop, breaking their 7-day winning run.
Smaller companies and broader market segments outperformed headline indices during the session.
Market participants are evaluating key domestic and global factors ahead of Monday's regular trading session.
summary:
Indian stock markets concluded the special Diwali Muhurat trading session on a muted note, with the Sensex and Nifty snapping a seven-day rally.
This session marked the start of Samvat 2083 and represented the first red Diwali close for Indian stocks in eight years, though smaller companies managed gains.
Investors now turn their attention to Monday's trading session following an otherwise strong week for domestic equities.
